subject: Nanotechnology
title: Nano Electrocatalysis for Water Splitting
description: A fast breakdown of Nano Electrocatalysis for Water Splitting for builders.

hook.text: Split water with electricity and you get hydrogen fuel — nano catalysts make the reaction faster and cheaper.

buildup.text: The oxygen evolution reaction is the bottleneck — it needs 300 mV overpotential even with the best bulk catalysts.

discovery.text: Nano-structured NiFe layered double hydroxides reduce overpotential by 100 mV — matching iridium oxide performance.

twist.text: High current densities cause bubble formation that blocks active sites — gas management is a nano-scale challenge.

climax.text: Industrial electrolyzers now use nanostructured non-precious catalysts — making green hydrogen cost-competitive.

punchline.text: Nano surfaces split water faster — turning electricity into clean hydrogen fuel.

quiz.question: How do nanostructured catalysts improve water splitting?
options: They heat the water to make it split spontaneously
They reduce the overpotential needed for the oxygen evolution reaction, improving efficiency
They filter out impurities in the water before splitting
